items.title: RYANAIR LAUNCHES RECORD MOROCCO WINTER SCHEDULE
items.summary: 2 NEW AIRCRAFT ($200M INVESTMENT), 17 NEW ROUTES, & 5.3M LOW FARE SEATS Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (Thurs, 6 Aug) announced its biggest ever Winter schedule in Morocco, offering 5.3m low-fares seats to/from 156 destinations, including 17 exciting new routes. items.title: RYANAIR MARKS 7 MILLION PASSENGERS THROUGH BELFAST INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT
items.summary: Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (29 Jul) announced that it has carried over 7m passengers through Belfast International Airport since it began operations to/from the airport a decade ago. items.title: RYANAIR AND AWS EXTEND AGREEMENT FOR ANOTHER 5 YEARS

items.title: RYANAIR WINS IRISH HIGH COURT RULING AGAINST EDREAMS

items.title: RYANAIR LAUNCHES RECORD WINTER 2026 SCHEDULE WITH 80M SEATS ACROSS EUROPE
items.summary: Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (16 Jul) launched a record schedule for Winter 2026, with 1,700 routes across 35 countries, including over 140 new routes. Ryanair’s record Winter 2026 schedule offers customers even more choice for their Winter 2026 getaways, including top winter sun destinations, ski trips, Christmas markets, or city escapes, at the lowest fares in Europe. Ryanair’s full Winter 2026 schedule is available to book now via the Ryanair App / website.
